summary: The root عتد (Etd) refers to preparation and readiness. عَتَادٌ signifies apparatus, implements, or equipage, especially for war, like weapons and beasts.
lane: عَتَادٌ ذ (S, A, O, L, Msb, K) and , (L, K,) or , (so in the O,) Apparatus; syn. عُدَّةٌ [q. v.]; (S, A, O, L, K;) which is said by some to be formed from عُتْدَةٌ , but others deny this; (L;) implements, or instruments, or the like; (S, O;) or weapons, beasts, and instruments, or equipage, of war: (L, Msb:) pl. أَعْتُدٌ (O, L, Msb, K) and أَعْتِدَةٌ (L, Msb) [both pls. of pauc.] and عُتُدٌ . (L.) One says, أَخَذَ لِلْأَمْرِ عَتَادَهُ He took his apparatus, or implements, or instruments, or the like, [or he prepared, or provided, himself, ] for the affair: (S, O:) or he took, for the affair, what he had prepared of weapons, and beasts, and instruments, or equipage, of war. (Msb.) -b2- And sometimes, (S, O,) عَتَادٌ signifies also A large drinking-cup or bowl: (S, O, K:) i. q. عَسْفٌ and صَحْنٌ : (IAar, L:) or a large drinking-cup or bowl ( عُسٌّ ) of [ wood of the tree called ] أَثْل . (AHn, TA.)

headwords.def: [aor. عَتُدَ,] (O, L, Msb, K,) inf. n. عَتَادٌ (O, Msb, K) and عَتَادَةٌ, (O, L, K,) It (a thing, L, Msb) was, or became, ready, at hand, or prepared. (O, L, Msb, K.) And عَتُدَ, inf. n. عَتَادٌ (L, TA) and عَتَادَةٌ, (TA,) It (a thing) was, or became, great, big, or bulky. (L, TA.)

(S, O, Msb, K,) inf. n. إِعْتَادٌ; (S;) and, (S, Msb, K,) inf. n. تَعْتِيدٌ; (S, K;) He made it ready, or prepared it, (S, O, Msb, K,) for a [ future ] day. (S, O.) The former verb occurs in the Kur xii. 31. (S, O, Msb.) Yaakoob says that the [former] ت in أَعْتَدْتُهُ is a substitute for the [former] د in أَعْدَدْتُهُ: and some say that أَعَدَّ is originally أَعْتَدَ; but others deny this. (L.)
تعتّد فِى صَنْعَتِهِ He was nice, or scrupulously nice and exact, in his work, art, or craft. (O, K.)

: see عَتِيدٌ. [Hence,] فَرَسٌ عَتَدٌ, as also, A horse made ready, or prepared, for running; (S, O, L, K;) of strong make; quick in leaping, or springing; not incongruous, unsound, faulty, or weak, in make; nor lax, or uncompact: (L:) or strong, and perfect in make: (ISk, S, O, K:) or that performs run after run: (O:) or made ready, or prepared, for riding: and applied alike to a male and to a female. (L.)
and عَتَدَةٌ: see what next follows.

(S, A, O, L, Msb, K) and, (L, K,) or, (so in the O,) Apparatus; syn. عُدَّةٌ [q. v.]; (S, A, O, L, K;) which is said by some to be formed from عُتْدَةٌ, but others deny this; (L;) implements, or instruments, or the like; (S, O;) or weapons, beasts, and instruments, or equipage, of war: (L, Msb:) pl. أَعْتُدٌ (O, L, Msb, K) and أَعْتِدَةٌ (L, Msb) [both pls. of pauc.] and عُتُدٌ.

A yearling goat; (Msb, K;) a young goat that pastures, and is strong, and has become a year old: (S, O, L:) or a kid that has begun to pasture: (L:) or that pastures, and has become strong; (Mgh, TA;) as also عَرِيضٌ: or that has become a جَ َع [ a year old, in the second year ]; and such is called عَرِيضٌ also; both of which appellations are applied to the male and the female; or such is only termed عَرِيضٌ; عتود signifying one that has become a ثَنِىّ [app.

A thing (S, O, L) ready, at hand, or prepared; (S, A, O, L, K;) as also [q. v.]: pl. [of pauc.] of the latter أَعْتَادٌ and [of mult.] عُتُدٌ: (Msb:) the former occurs in the Kur l. 22, (O, L,) in this sense: or as meaning near: (L:) or as meaning, (O,) i. e. made ready, or prepared. (K.)

A receptacle for perfume (A, Msb) and unguent (A) or unguents: (Msb:) a kind of wooden tray ( طَبْلَة ), or a small round box ( حُقَّة ), in which are the perfume of a man, (O, K,) or his unguent, (O,) and the perfume of the bride, (O, K,) prepared ( أُعْتِدَتْ ) for what she requires of perfume, and substance for fumigation, and a comb, and other things; [formed from عَتِيدٌ;] the ة being affixed to it as being a subst.: (O:) or a طَبْل [or small round basket covered with leather ]…

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
mentions_note: Forms Lane discusses inside another entry rather than defining as a headword. Values index into headwords[].
